The Evans book is one of my favorites, and I totally agree with Jeffrey’s assessment on the number of times needed to really grasp the concepts in there. As such, I thought it would be a good idea to share one of the ways that I give myself an Evans-DDD refresher…the DDD Quickly book that one can find here: http://www.infoq.com/…/domain-driven-d
I also blogged a little about it at: blogs.collaborare.net/…/post.aspx
